author: StewieFG
body:
Hey guys :)

Lately I have been making a map for tourmanent but then I realised it's too big for tourmanent in my opinion, so I decidedso it'll be a regular Destroy The Monument map.

P.S: If a mapdev still thinks it's ok for the tourmanent I'll be if this map would play on the tourmanent.

By the way, the name is based on a movie I saw yesterday which I really liked and the terrain there was really similar to mycelium so I decided to call the map Grip Reaper like the movie I watched was called.

Creators: ElectraXdroid

Gamemode: Nebula- Destroy The Monument

Info: 25v25 for normal, 10v10 max for tourmanent

Images (Full Gallery): http://imgur.com/a/Ugkfl 

Download: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/klab26qlrc8qmbh/AACi53Kokhuvgaudfgalcd1Ra?dl=0

YAML: Coming soon.

Feedback is always appreciated :)

replies.body: It looks pretty good. The only problem that I have with it is that it feels very similar to other nebula maps like embers and consilium. It seems like the game play will be really similar and your map has potential, just keep working on it and I'm sure that in the end it will eventually look great!

replies.body: That's what I was thinking too. The problem is, it just looks like that, if you actually download the map and play it, it won't look like it. replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
I think what Rile meant is the position/placement and shape/looks of the islands in your map are similar to Embers (especially the middle ones to be honest since it's a bunch of circles and stuff). Similarity to Consilium might come from the towers you made and connected by adding some sort of path at the top of them, which is pretty much something that was done in Consilium with the exception Consilium had iron bars if I'm not wrong?
Pretty sure I told you already but the map is flat, it could help having different height levels on it like ladders on Rendezvous I or just islands at different levels like in Embers.
Gameplay wise I can't see this map playing as good as or better than the maps that are already in rotations, and what we strive for is to get maps that are as good or better than the ones we already have, then again it's just my instinct and nothing confirmed at all so if your map gets accepted by another Map Developer it could be tested and then prove me wrong/right.
I can say the thing I like the most on this map is the middle island except it's really flat and it doesn't really have anything special to it, but hey I like how you built it so that's extra points.
Overall the map needs more unique-ness, a better island placement and better island shape (while it may seem the shape of the islands only contributes to the aesthetical side of the map, it also changes gameplay). Perhaps using a different material other than Mycelium will work, too? That's just my personal view on it.
Hope you can make good progress with your map Eric, good luck and remember, never give up. :)
